title: Update Program Financials
taskDescription:
Evaluate if there are changes that impact the financials. If yes, run again the Risk Strategist Model (RSM) and compare the actual financials with the required financials.
The Required Financials are the latest approved by BU, this means the ones approved for the Quote or the ones reported in the latest approved AR.
The Actual Financials are the latest re-calculated financials as per the RSM based on actual data or latest program assumptions. Assumptions are valid only if the implementation is already agreed and approved internally and with the customer.
The following is a list of potential root causes to be added on the explanation if financials are below target. Add first the root cause and then the detailed explanation. If the root cause is not in the list, please add it:
- Design changes
- BOM cost increase
- Volume Changes
- SOP Postponed
- Process Issue
- Initial tasks assigned at Gate 0
- Inflationary effects.
- Raw material Index definition.
Check the attachment for further details
